t: 土伦战役导致数名皇家海军上尉被送上军事法庭，战争条款也被修改。
te: The Battle of Toulon causes several Royal Navy captains to be court-martialed, and the Articles of War to be amended.
dz: 奥地利王位继承战争：土伦战役导致数名皇家海军上尉被送上军事法庭，战争条款也被修改。
de: War of the Austrian Succession: The Battle of Toulon causes several Royal Navy captains to be court-martialed, and the Articles of War to be amended.

t: "兰开斯特条约"(Treaty of Lancaster)中,易洛魁人将阿列根尼山脉和俄亥俄河…
te: The Treaty of Lancaster, in which the Iroquois cede lands between the Allegheny Mountains and the Ohio River to the Bri…
dz: "兰开斯特条约"(Treaty of Lancaster)中,易洛魁人将阿列根尼山脉和俄亥俄河之间的土地割让给英国殖民地,在宾夕法尼亚州的兰开斯特签订.
de: The Treaty of Lancaster, in which the Iroquois cede lands between the Allegheny Mountains and the Ohio River to the British colonies, is signed in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

t: 法国和西班牙在麦当娜·德尔奥尔莫战役中击败撒丁岛，但很快就不得不从撒丁岛撤军。
te: France and Spain defeat Sardinia at the Battle of Madonna dell'Olmo, but soon have to withdraw from Sardinia.
dz: 奥地利王位继承战争：法国和西班牙在麦当娜·德尔奥尔莫战役中击败撒丁岛，但很快就不得不从撒丁岛撤军。
de: War of the Austrian Succession: France and Spain defeat Sardinia at the Battle of Madonna dell'Olmo, but soon have to withdraw from Sardinia.
